card.name: Final letters of 'tablets' and plural nouns
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split word, most often the plural ending -ts in 'tablets' (TABLETS, tablets, microtablets) in drug label text. It also fires on the end of split names or plurals such as 'bibs', 'Pickett' and 'McKibben'.

modes.label: Tablets split at the end
modes.description: The final -ts or -TS piece of 'tablets' after 'table' or 'TABLE' in drug names and headings.
modes.example: AMINOPHEN TABLE<<TS>> See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning

modes.label: Split surnames
modes.description: The last piece of a surname that the text splits into parts.
modes.example: McKib<<ben>> is a scholar in residence at Middlebury

modes.label: Plural supply words
modes.description: The plural -s ending on a split item in a list of baby supplies.
modes.example: Burp cloths, bib<<s>> - Cotton swabs - Di

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted words, which are mixed and mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the closing letters of 'tablets' when the word is split into pieces, and sometimes on the end of a split name.
